scripts.build: esbuild src/client/app/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/app.js --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2022 --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" && esbuild src/client/app/sw.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/sw.js --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2022 --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace && node scripts/inline.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mediator.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mimi.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.rp-signer.json
scripts.smoke:didcomm-mediator: esbuild scripts/didcomm-mediator-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node26 --log-level=warning --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'node:module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist-server/smoke.mjs && node dist-server/smoke.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm reachability --quiet && pnpm test
